traits.name: Absorb Force
traits.text: ⬲ (arcane, evocation, force); Frequency once per round Trigger A magic missile is fired at the witchwyrd, and the witchwyrd is aware of it and has a free hand Effect The witchwyrd "catches" the missile, absorbing it and causing that hand to glow while it holds this energy. A hand that's holding energy can't be used for any other purpose except to use.

traits.name: Force Bolt.
traits.text: The energy lasts for 6 rounds or until it is released.

traits.name: Force Bolt
traits.text: ⬻ to ⬽ (arcane, evocation, force); The witchwyrd fires one magic missile per action spent (dealing 1d4+1 (1d4+1) force damage each). They can't spend more actions on this ability than they have free hands. If they use a hand that has Absorbed Force, that hand hurls two missiles instead of one, expending the held energy.
